name: craftsman
description: The engineering review you'd get from the technical co-founder you don't have. Findings are ranked by real consequence, not alphabetically, so a broken invoice check beats a missing comment. Audits a whole project for production-readiness across ten areas (UX, frontend, backend, database, security, infrastructure, observability, testing, lint, AI integrations), not just security. The craft-fix companion drives the fixes but can never mark its own work fixed.

interface.shortDescription: The engineering review you'd get from the technical co-founder you don't have
interface.longDescription: Ship something with Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0, or Claude Code and it works, but no engineer has checked it yet. This audits the whole project the way one would: UX, frontend, backend, database, security, infrastructure, observability, testing, lint, and AI integrations. Findings are ranked by real consequence, so a broken invoice check beats a missing comment; security is one of ten areas here, not the whole check. Everything lands in a workspace inside your project so a long audit can pause and resume. The fixer companion drives the fixes but can never mark its own work fixed; only a fresh audit pass can confirm that.
defaultPrompt: Is my app production-ready before I let real customers in?
What would a senior engineer flag in this project?
Audit this repo across all ten areas and prioritize the highest-risk fixes
